findings.title: Still present since round 3 (r3-W2): the pullback_yields app7 leg writes the developer's real ~/.pp-settings.bin on every native test run (release AND PP_DEBUG legs)
findings.detail: effect_settings_adjust unconditionally tails settings_save_app; the zeroed fixture leaves settings_path_override empty -> settings_path() = the real HOME dotfile. Mechanically re-proven this round (mtime + bytes: v2 file with auto_pullback OFF). The proc's own comment: 'a test must never touch it'.
findings.fix: Set app7.settings_path_override to a temp path (the exec-level adjust-test pattern) before the toggle leg.

findings.title: Still present since round 3 (r3-W3): pullback_feed caps the spawn-event mapping at ids[8] — a 9+ spawn frame silently returns and skips the pullback
findings.detail: camera_newest_terminals breaks at len(ids)=8 -> found != n_spawns -> silent return; a genuine seed in a large catch-up burst never pulls back. Unreachable at interval 80 (5-tick frame cap) but the interval is balance.json data.
findings.fix: Clamp n_spawns to the buffer and map the newest 8 (the newest-first walk keeps a truncated mapping correct for the newest seed), or size the buffer to the max same-frame spawns.

findings.title: Still present since round 3 (r3-W4): the W7 same-window exclusion's correctness silently depends on terminal_spawn_interval_ticks exceeding the 5-tick frame cap — unasserted anywhere
findings.detail: At interval <= 5 two spawns share a frame and the frame-level exclusion hides the first from the second's plan-time view (false SEEDs). Inert today, wrong when the data knob moves.
findings.fix: Assert interval > max ticks/frame where balance loads, or derive the exclusion window from the interval instead of the frame slice.
